Olive Roll-Ups
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 17, 2009 - 11:37pm

Ingredients




4 slc boiled ham
1 tablespoon cream cheese, whipped
24 smalls pimiento stuffed green 
Preparation

1 Spread a generous 1/2 tablespoon whipped cream cheese on each of 4 slices of boiled ham. Cut each slice of ham into 6 strips. Wrap strips around 24 small green olives. If desired, secure with cocktail picks. 2 NOTES : Recipe doubles well.
